events.verdict: Bagley III (DAL) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Clingan's (POR) layup attempt.
Washington (DAL) engages and disengages with Henderson (POR) as both players come together as the pick is set.
Marshall (DAL) brings his hands towards Holiday (POR) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
Avdija (POR) contests Marshall's (DAL) jump shot attempt and the contact that occurs to Marshall's arm after the release is marginal.
Bagley III (DAL) establishes a screening position outside of Holiday's (POR) field of view and does not give him a step to avoid the contact.
Avdija (POR) establishes a screening position in WIlliams' (DAL) path and engages with Williams before disengaging as Avdija rolls towards the basket after setting the pick.
The ball is last touched by Holiday (POR) prior to it going out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Dallas.
Bagley III (DAL) grasps Clingan's (POR) jersey and immediately releases it as the contact that occurs during the pursuit of the rebound is marginal.
Henderson (POR) brushes Bagley III's (DAL) arm and the contact that occurs during Bagley III's shot attempt near the rim is marginal.
Flagg (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Clingan (POR) as the steal occurs.
Henderson (POR) commits a take foul on Williams (DAL).
The ball is last touched by Bagley III (DAL) prior to it going out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Portland.
Holiday (POR) engages and disengages from Williams (DAL) prior to receiving the incoming pass.
Williams (DAL) legally contests Holiday's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) commits a take foul on Marshall (DAL).
Marshall (DAL) fails to establish a legal guarding position in Avdija's (POR) path and initiates contact to Avdija's body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Camara (POR) commits a take foul on Williams (DAL).
Marshall (DAL) contests Henderson's (POR) jump shot attempt and the contact that occurs to Henderson's arm after the release is marginal.
